cnt-3 error mii-lm-studie-logicalmodel.Studiendesign.Rekrutierungsstand There SHALL be a code with a value of "1" if there is a value. If system is present, it SHALL be UCUM. ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
qty-3 error mii-lm-studie-logicalmodel.Studiendesign.Rekrutierungsstand If a code for the unit is present, the system SHALL also be present code.empty() or system.exists()
